StatsCmd.Name: Stats Command
StatsCmd.Hint: Root chat command used to trigger Sadness Chan (e.g. !sadness).

DieType.Name: Observed Die Faces
DieType.Hint: The die type to observe for rolls and critical results (e.g. 20 for d20).

CrtFail.Name: Critical Fail Value
CrtFail.Hint: Die result value considered a critical failure (default: 1).

CrtSuccess.Name: Critical Success Value
CrtSuccess.Hint: Die result value considered a critical success (default: 20).

FailChance.Name: Critical Fail Whisper Chance
FailChance.Hint: Probability (0 to 1) that Sadness Chan comments on a critical fail.

SuccessChance.Name: Critical Success Whisper Chance
SuccessChance.Hint: Probability (0 to 1) that Sadness Chan comments on a critical success.

Title.Name: Sadness Chan Name
Title.Hint: Display name shown in chat headers.

PublicStats.Name: Public Stats Messages
PublicStats.Hint: If enabled, stats commands are posted publicly instead of whispered to the caller.

PublicComments.Name: Public Reaction Comments
PublicComments.Hint: If enabled, critical reaction comments are posted publicly instead of whispered.

ShowAverage.Name: Show Average Roll
ShowAverage.Hint: Display average roll in stats cards.

Plotting.Name: Show Roll Histogram
Plotting.Hint: Display graphical histogram plot in stats cards.

ImageBorder.Name: Show Portrait Border
ImageBorder.Hint: Render border styling around portrait avatars.

ResetLevel.Name: Reset Permissions
ResetLevel.Hint: Minimum user role required to reset their own roll history.

Debug.Name: Enable Debugging
Debug.Hint: Print diagnostic information to the console.
